title: Dipped Berry Bites
description: Freeze-dried raspberry powder mixed into white almond butter, rolled into balls and dipped in white chocolate for an elegant petit-four.
steps: Blitz the freeze-dried raspberries to a fine powder in a blender. Stir into the almond butter until fully combined.
Roll into small balls (20p-piece size) and arrange on greaseproof paper. Freeze for 90 minutes to harden.
Melt the white chocolate over boiling water or in the microwave. Allow to cool slightly.
Remove bites from the freezer, re-roll into spheres. Dip each one in the chocolate, place on greaseproof paper.
Freeze for another 90 minutes to set. Keeps for a week in the fridge.
notes: Makes around 14 bites. Per bite estimate. Work fast when dipping so the filling stays firm.
